channel.title: The College Fix - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The College Fix (thecollegefix.com)

item.title: Virginia agrees to end in-state tuition for illegal immigrants to resolve DOJ lawsuit
item.description: 'Illegal immigrants cannot be given benefits that are not available to American citizens' says Virginia AG.

item.title: Harvard president admits faculty activism is a problem
item.description: Harvard President Alan Garber acknowledges the rise of political activism among faculty as problematic. He said excellent teaching once required objectivity.

item.title: No word from Trump admin on investigating claim Biden pressured schools on ‘gender ideology’
item.description: A whistleblower claims Biden's Education Department ignored a court order against enforcing Title IX changes regarding gender identity in schools. Empower Oversight is urging the Trump administration to investigate these allegations.

item.title: ‘Embolden Christ followers’: Counteract USA launches faith-based student ‘cells’ on colleges nationwide
item.description: 'Movement of Christians committed to changing their culture for the sake of the gospel of Jesus.'

item.title: Bill seeks to ban noncitizens from being eligible for in-state college tuition
item.description: 'My bill will put our students first by ensuring that only Americans are eligible for in-state tuition.'

item.title: CU Boulder professor: Trump’s Venezuela action shows U.S. is ‘fascist authoritarian regime’
item.description: A CU Boulder professor criticized the U.S. as a "fascist authoritarian regime" in response to President Trump's military action in Venezuela.

item.title: Details emerge regarding reparations meeting at U. Illinois: Capitalism called ‘theft’
item.description: The University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign hosted an African Descent-Citizens Reparations Commission during which two of its professors and one of its researchers championed reparations.

item.title: Campus sexual violence rate closer to 1%, not 25%, study suggests
item.description: A new study further undermines the claim that 1 in 5 women are victims of sexual violence while in college.

item.title: Purdue campus says it cannot find any Americans to teach marketing classes for $127,000
item.description: Purdue University Northwest must hire foreigners to teach marketing classes, the school claims.

item.title: Transparency or threat? UNC policy to make syllabi public draws mixed reactions
item.description: The University of North Carolina System will require all course syllabi to be publicly accessible, aiming to enhance transparency at taxpayer-funded institutions. While some faculty fear criticism and threats, supporters argue that public access is justified.
